name: Maplewood Voyager Infinite
rewards: 3x points on flights, hotels and dining, 1x on everything else
description: Premium travel credit card with no foreign transaction fees, airport lounge access, comprehensive travel insurance and trip cancellation coverage. Earn points on flights, hotels and dining abroad.

name: Lakeshore Passport Card
rewards: 2x points on travel, gas and transit
description: Travel rewards card with no foreign transaction fees on purchases made outside Canada. Includes travel medical insurance, rental car coverage and points redeemable with any airline.

name: Aurora Explorer No-Fee
rewards: 1.5x points on travel bookings and online purchases in other currencies
description: No annual fee travel card with no foreign transaction fees. Ideal for occasional travellers on a budget and anyone who shops online in US dollars.

name: Borealis Altitude Elite
rewards: 5x points on flights booked direct, 3x on hotels, yearly travel credit
description: Luxury travel card with unlimited airport lounge visits, priority boarding, hotel elite status, a yearly travel credit and a personal concierge service. A 2.5% fee applies to purchases made in other currencies.

name: Harbourline Cash Back Plus
rewards: 2% cash back on groceries, 1% on everything else
description: No annual fee cash back card earning 2% cash back on groceries and 1% on all other everyday purchases. Simple flat rewards with no points to track.

name: Maplewood Cash Back Infinite
rewards: 4% cash back on groceries and gas, 2% on recurring bills, 1% on everything else
description: High cash back card with 4% back on groceries and gas, 2% on recurring bills and streaming subscriptions, and 1% back on everything else.

name: Lakeshore Grocery Rewards
rewards: 5x points at grocery stores and pharmacies
description: Earn bonus points at grocery stores and pharmacies. Points redeem for free groceries, gift cards or statement credits. No annual fee.

name: Aurora Student Starter
rewards: 1% cash back on textbooks, food delivery and transit
description: Designed for college and university students building credit for the first time. No annual fee, a starter credit limit and cash back on textbooks, food delivery and transit.

name: Harbourline Student Travel
rewards: 1x points on all purchases, free credit score monitoring
description: Student card with no foreign transaction fees for students studying abroad or on exchange. No annual fee and free credit score monitoring to help build a credit history.

name: Borealis Secured Builder
rewards: No rewards, reports to both credit bureaus monthly
description: Secured credit card backed by a refundable security deposit. Built for anyone rebuilding damaged credit or establishing a credit history from scratch.

name: Cedarline Newcomer Card
rewards: 1% cash back for the first year
description: Credit card for newcomers to Canada and international students who have no Canadian credit history yet. No annual fee and helps build a credit score from day one.

name: Lakeshore Low Rate Card
rewards: No rewards, lower interest instead
description: Low interest rate credit card for people who carry a balance month to month. A reduced annual interest rate saves money on purchases you cannot pay off right away.

name: Maplewood Balance Transfer
rewards: 0.99% introductory interest on balance transfers for 12 months
description: Balance transfer card with a low introductory interest rate for 12 months on transferred balances. Consolidate high interest debt and pay it down faster.

name: Aurora Gas and Commute
rewards: 3% back on gas, EV charging, parking and transit
description: Rewards card for drivers and commuters with 3% back on gas, electric vehicle charging, parking and public transit.

name: Harbourline Dining and Entertainment
rewards: 5x points at restaurants, food delivery, movies and concerts
description: Earn 5x points at restaurants, food delivery, bars, movie theatres and concert tickets. Includes presale access to live entertainment events.

name: Borealis Business Edge
rewards: 2% back on office supplies, advertising and software
description: Small business credit card with free employee cards, expense tracking tools and 2% back on office supplies, advertising and software subscriptions.

name: Cedarline Everyday No-Fee
rewards: 0.5% cash back on all purchases
description: Simple everyday credit card with no annual fee, purchase protection, extended warranty coverage and cash back on every purchase.

name: Lakeshore Hotel Rewards Elite
rewards: 6x points on hotel stays, a free night certificate every year
description: Hotel rewards card with a yearly free night certificate, elite hotel status, room upgrades and points on hotel stays worldwide.

name: Maplewood Online Shopper
rewards: 3% back on online shopping, streaming and digital subscriptions
description: Earn 3% back on online shopping, streaming and digital subscriptions, with no foreign transaction fees on purchases from international websites.

name: Aurora Green Rewards
rewards: 2x points on transit, cycling, EV charging and sustainable brands
description: Eco-friendly card made from recycled plastic. Earn bonus rewards on public transit, cycling, electric vehicle charging and sustainable brands, with points donated to tree planting.
